rationale: ZIN rule (owner, 17 October 2026): all art is new and image-generated; never copy assets from other mods. This overrides the kit's third-party source search, so no external source exists for this reference.

generator.prompt: A single full-body character for a 3D model reference, for a dark painterly fantasy grand-strategy game. Straight front view, the whole figure from head to feet visible and centred with margin on every side, standing on nothing, relaxed A-pose with arms angled about 30 degrees away from the body and legs slightly apart, hands open and empty, fingers separated. He holds no weapon, no shield, no staff and no banner; nothing is attached to the hands. Plain flat uniform light grey (#c8c8c8) background, even soft studio lighting, no cast shadow, no ground, no scenery, no text, no frame. Clear readable silhouette, no loose cloth streamers, no thin floating parts, armour pieces solid and attached to the body. The figure is a Magical Forest elf warden: a tall slender elf with long pale hair tied back and pointed ears, wearing layered leaf-shaped green and silver scale armour over a moss-green tunic, a short hooded mantle fastened at the chest, fitted bracers and soft tall boots. Calm, ageless face.
